questions.question:
A group of class X students goes to a picnic during the winter holidays. The positions of three friends Aman, Kirti and Chahat are shown by the points $P(2, 5)$, $Q(4, 4)$ and $R(8, 3)$.

(i) Find the distance between P and R. (1)

(ii) Is Q the mid-point of PR? Justify by finding the mid-point of PR. (1)

(iii) Find the point on the $x$-axis which is equidistant from P and Q. OR Let S be a point which divides the line joining PQ in the ratio $2 : 3$. Find the coordinates of S. (2)
answer_steps: (ii) Mid-point of $PR = \left(\dfrac{2 + 8}{2}, \dfrac{5 + 3}{2}\right) = (5, 4) \neq Q(4, 4)$, so Q is not the mid-point.
